stemMd: A velocity-time graph shows constant velocity 6 m/s from t=0 to t=5 s. What displacement occurs during that interval?
explanationMd: Displacement is the area under a velocity-time graph. Here it is a rectangle of height 6 and width 5, giving 30 m.

distractorRationale.a: This uses elapsed time as displacement.
distractorRationale.d: This adds quantities with different units.
